Gold and Crude Prices Slip Amid US‑Iran Talks and Fed Comments

Gold prices fell as traders assessed progress in US‑Iran negotiations and considered Federal Reserve officials’ remarks on how energy costs could affect the path for interest rates. At the same time, crude oil prices dropped by $1, reflecting a better supply outlook and optimism about the US‑Iran talks.
